audit.whatIsWrong: Viktor's E is named Death Ray across the content layer; the kit names it Hextech Ray. Enemy pronouns are male throughout the full layer (Lux is she/her). breakdown.cooldowns has no numbers.
audit.why: Kit file is authority: E text says 'fire a Hextech Ray'; Lux Q 10s, W 12-10s, E 10-8s, R 60/50/40s; Viktor W 17s, R 120/100/80s.
audit.corrected: Renamed to Hextech Ray everywhere it appears; pronouns fixed; real cooldowns written into breakdown.cooldowns and dontsFull[2].d.

edits.before: - Lux Light Binding: matchup-defining — Everything keys off the root — minion-block it and her combo never starts. It governs your forward steps. - W Gravity Field spent on poke is a death you scheduled. - Hold the R for the fight that decides something.

Missing interaction not folded in for length reasons: Lux's Light Binding can interrupt Chaos Storm (R is flagged channel/interruptible in the kit) — worth a future report entry.
